title: VDBE connection changes, statement expiration, and metadata access

scope.rationale: These source helpers are the small connection/statement metadata boundary: publish connection changes, opt a statement into change counting, expire all linked statements with immediate/advisory strength, expose db/preparation flags, and reset the step result. They operate on the same exact linked Vdbe state.
excluded_responsibilities: VDBE reset/finalize lifecycle beyond rc reset

external_source_responsibilities: Caller holds connection mutex for change publication/expiration
dependencies.caller_closure: All six active metadata functions are assigned; their exact fields and linked-list owners are covered by dependencies. Public APIs and reset/reprepare orchestration remain follow-on units.

inputs: connection/change delta, Vdbe, expiration code, or metadata accessor target
outputs: nChange assignment and nTotalChange accumulation; changeCntOn; every linked expired=code+1; db/prepFlags; rc=OK
contracts.ownership: No allocations or owner transitions. Expiration traverses but does not relink the connection Vdbe list.
contracts.state_and_results: SetChanges replaces current nChange while adding to total. CountChanges is sticky true. Expiration code 0 maps to immediate 1 and code 1 to advisory 2.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Caller holds connection mutex. No callback or I/O.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: No failure/OOM path. ResetStepResult permits subsequent step/reset logic to observe OK.

representation_differences: Vdbe bitfields are exact packed Zig fields; all counters/results retain C integer widths.

oracle.protocol: The shared worker creates two linked VDBEs, publishes seven changes, enables change counting, applies immediate then advisory expiration to both nodes, checks database/preparation accessors, and resets SQLITE_INTERRUPT to OK in a 366-observation trace.
oracle.normalization: All counters, flags and results are exact; database pointer normalizes only to owner identity.

assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No I/O/callback; mutex remains caller obligation.
assurance.malformed_input: Source expects valid connection/list and expiration code convention; worker uses exact owners and both documented codes.
assurance.continuation: Metadata remains valid through later swap/delete cleanup; expiration does not mutate links.
assurance.performance: Constant-time accessors/updates and one linear statement-list traversal.

integration.native_call_path: Symbolic worker uses exact two-node connection list. Public change/reprepare/reset callers remain partially handwritten.

independent_review.notes: Requires production caller integration, assurance closure, and independent review.

known_blockers: Integrate public changes, reset, and expiration callers.
